critical_findings: Old config says test_mae but report.valid_metrics and best.pt were selected on validation MAE in matching historical trainer; test_mae disables early stopping and requests separate downstream test sweep.
Old vs first round: max_epochs20->30, min_epochs8->1, same patience7; first-round actual FullKD29 epochs/best22, ICD11/best4. Old both20/best19,15.
Old and first-round FullKD use Probe2026 TAV. Their UniformICD common FullKD terms still use Probe2026; interaction supervision is three probes2026/2027/2028.

Frozen teacher/input assets compare equal after historical path normalization. All three stale recorded hashes (manifest, base protocol, Probe2026 report) match exactly after byte replacement /data/sjq/kd -> /home/wy/sjq/kd. This proves those three current contents differ solely by that prefix migration from recorded content.
Equal architecture and declared seed do not prove bitwise initialization equality: no historical initial parameter hash exists.
Uniform ICD reduction order changed mathematically equivalently; BF16 and floating point training trajectories may differ, but audit does not causally attribute MAE differences.
unresolved_historical_evidence: Historical runtime torch/transformers/CUDA versions and full execution environment not retained per run
Full old transitive dependency source hashes were not recorded; b50cd6c versions provide contextual evidence only
No causal identification of numerical contribution to old/new MAE differences
phase1_requirements: Three-Probe common FullKD target for all8 groups
